text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Oil and gas workers' union threatens to strike over a pay hike disagreement. The union accuses state-owned oil and gas firm Sonatrach directorate of reneging on a deal.
- The authorities backtrack on furthering democratic rights: the Berber Tamazight language teaching was scrapped.
- A letter from the energy ministry put an end to negotiations between Sonatrach and workers'union. The dispute revives.
